Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE LXX OF 1995
ORDINANCE LXX OF 1995
PRIME MINISTER'S PENSION
ORDINANCE, 1995
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Prime
Minister's Pension Ordinance, 1995.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Admissibility of pension etc

ORDINANCE LXX OF 1995
ORDINANCE LXX OF 1995
PRIME MINISTER'S PENSION
ORDINANCE, 1995
2. Admissibility of pension, etc.‑‑There shall be payable
to every person who having held the office of the Prime Minister in accordance
with Article 91 of the Constitution has ceased to hold such office, a monthly
pension for life as is admissible to a former President in accordance with the
provisions of the President's Pension Act, 1974 (IX of 1975), hereinafter
referred to as the said Act, and such other facilities as are specified in clause
(a) of the Schedule thereof.

Provision of facilities to the spouse of the deceased prime minister

ORDINANCE LXX OF 1995
ORDINANCE LXX OF 1995
PRIME MINISTER'S PENSION
ORDINANCE, 1995
3. Provision of facilities to
the spouse of the deceased Prime
Minister.‑‑ The spouse of a deceased Prime Minister referred to
in section 2, shall be entitled to the facilities as are admissible to the
spouse of the deceased President under the provisions of the said Act.

Repeal

ORDINANCE LXX OF 1995
ORDINANCE LXX OF 1995
PRIME MINISTER'S PENSION
ORDINANCE, 1995
4. Repeal.‑‑The Prime Minister's Pension Ordinance, 1995
(XXX of 1995), is hereby repealed.
